Definition: Does the government maintain a digital address register?
Comments: No credible evidence found after searching address register digital addressing system; only postal codes, no national digital register.
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: No source was originally cited, and the 'No' finding is contradicted by evidence: Mozambique has a legally established national postal addressing system (Código de Endereçamento Postal, CEP) run by INCM, piloted in Manhiça from 2020 (US$33m budget, phased rollout to five more cities) and still being revised as recently as September 2024 (new 8-digit code structure). This shows an active but incomplete system, not the absence of one. Recalculated to 3 (Under development); no evidence of full nationwide deployment was found, so 'Partially/Fully deployed' is not supported.

Definition: What proportion of businesses does the register cover?
Comments: No specific % found; formal sector partial coverage assumed 20-49%.
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: No source was originally cited. UNU-WIDER (2024) survey of manufacturing MSMEs found roughly half lack any state registration and only ~11% hold national tax registration alongside other formalities; a World Bank study (2019) notes formal manufacturing firms are only ~7% of all firms, consistent with widely reported ~90% informality in the economy. This points to register coverage below 20%, not 20-49%; recalculated to 1. Figures are sector-specific (manufacturing MSMEs) rather than an economy-wide census, so this is flagged for human review to confirm against an official business-registrar statistic.

Definition: Does the government maintain a digital population register?
Comments: No credible evidence found after searching population register, national population register digital, civil register of persons, ID4D Mozambique, gov sites, academic papers. Civil registration exists but separate population register not evidenced.
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original 'No' finding is contradicted: World Bank ID4D country data (2024) identifies DNIC (Direcção Nacional de Identificação Civil, Ministry of Interior) as custodian of a 'National Population Register (NPR)' linked to the National Identity Card, and a May 2026 government tender for a national digital-ID/e-signature platform confirms the NPR is an existing system that new infrastructure will integrate with via the X-Road interoperability platform. Recalculated to 4 (Partially deployed): the register is operational for ID issuance but full CRVS and cross-agency data-exchange integration is still under development.
